dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Dry as a bone! You're handy, I'll give you that.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: One more thing, and it's a bit trickier. Some folks outside have been connecting to the power without paying.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: That's going to come straight off your electricity bill. Head out that door and disconnect them.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Fair warning though, they're not exactly going to thank you for it. Keep your wits about you out there.
